steps.units: flow_p90: 90th percentile of crystal-masked optical flow from frame i to i+1, px at 1200
steps.rule: draw frame i+1 over frame i at alpha f only where blend[i] = 1: at f = 0.5 at most 0.05 of crystal pixels off the true in-between by more than 24/255, and their 99th percentile at most 48 (picture-aware; elsewhere cut)

source: hero/dendrite_gen.py seed 7, Blender 4.5.11 Cycles, 96 spp, satin steel (no emission)
